ValidationRule.description: Stage gate: Letting, Completed and later stages need Headline rent (per year) and Close date.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(RecordType.DeveloperName = "Letting", CASE(StageName, "Enquiry", 1, "Requirement qualified", 2, "Viewing", 3, "Offer", 4, "Heads of terms", 5, "Referencing", 6, "Legals", 7, "Completed", 8, 0) >= 8, OR(ISBLANK(Headline_rent__c), ISBLANK(CloseDate)))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Fill in Headline rent (per year) and Close date before moving to Completed.
